    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"

>
[Apprentice Sea Witch](/Feats.aspx?ID=5349) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 37

</column>

---

You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know. Once per day, you can cast either [_create water_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1476) or [_hydraulic push_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1561) as a 1st-rank primal innate spell. Each time you cast _create water_, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.
name: Apprentice Sea Witch
